title: ETA / Unitas 6497-2 — Exploded Watch Anatomy
summary: A movement-first 3D explainer of a large hand-wound mechanical watch with causal winding and setting, stored reserve, geometry-constrained Swiss lever release, dynamic balance amplitude, and an explicit educational isochronism model that lets amplitude change simulated rate.

facts.Current pass: M5e normalized amplitude → frequency/rate error → oscillator phase drift → escapement/train timing
